rows.en: "My dear Hustler"? Hahaha… Are you talking to me?
Yes… I'm talking to you!
How rude!! I won't be talked down to like that by a mere computer!
Should you really speak to me in that tone? My dear Hustler!
Uwaaaagh!!
Kindly remember that I have a heat ray… my dear Hustler!
Nngh…
Captain Gomez! It seems the TDF has learned the secret of that helmet…
But… the one in contact with that robot was just a child…
A child?
Yes…
In that case… there's nothing to worry about, Brain!
Hustler, stop addressing me so familiarly! From now on, call me Mister!
Getting a big head, are you!? Brain?
Mister Brain! Even if it's only a child, it's bad news that he can make contact with that robot!
The TDF will certainly use the child! And that means… they'll use that robot as well.
Chief!
Yes… Captain.
Since Professor Hustler can't dispose of a single child, why don't we take care of it in his place…
Sir!
Kuh…
You're on our side, aren't you? Right?
Hey, robot, answer me.
Saburo, look into the robot's eyes! It's trying to tell you something.
Okay… What are you saying?
What's your name?
Seven…teen? Your name is Seventeen, right?

Then…

One, Seven… Your name is "One-Seven", isn't it?
I see… So that's the signal for YES?
One-Seven!! Will you really lend us your strength?
Please answer us! Can't you hear?
Saburo, could you try asking it?
One-Seven, you're on our side, right?
Okaaay…
As I thought… it only seems to respond to Saburo.
Thank you, One-Seven… You're my friend!

You feel the same way, One-Seven?

One-Seven… you're a good guy. From now on, let's join forces and fight the Brain Party!! My life is yours!!
Answering young Saburo's cry, a giant of steel appeared like a raging god… The one who smashed the invading robot was young Saburo's ally. His name: "Daitetsujin One-Seven"!
The great melee was brought to a close by the power of One-Seven, Giant Robo and the other robots of justice that appeared one after another!
The great melee was brought to a close by the power of One-Seven, Red Baron and the other robots of justice that appeared one after another!
A few days later… young Saburo, now bonded heart to heart with One-Seven, joined the International Peace Organization's Red Muffler Squad to fight the Brain Party.
A robot war, now joined by the terrifying strategies of the giant electronic brain, Brain… When will it ever be settled? Today, too, the giants of justice fight on.
Ah…
What's wrong, [HERO2]?
My phone… I forgot to hang up!
No way!? So this whole time…?
Looks like it was still connected…
Ugh, [HERO2]… you're gonna be super broke!!
Haaah…

Oh? Goro… that's an unusual pendant design, isn't it?
It's modeled on a rose, isn't it? Half on each side… a design where two halves make one.
Which means… could it be a matching set with your sweetheart?
Hmm… so young folks going steady carry things like that these days, huh?
Going steady?

It means boyfriend and girlfriend.

Better to just remember "dating". Nobody but Oyassan says "going steady" these days.
What!? It's all the same thing. Honestly, young people these days…

Um… I've been curious about this for a while…

Goro, that pendant… could it be?
It looks like a rose, with half on each side… a design where two halves make one, right?
